mission: Use the standard library compare for the admin token on the API. A missing, wrong, empty or non-ASCII token is refused with the same response as today. An empty configured token outside development still fails closed. Who is accepted does not change. Owner approval is under security_or_secrets_policy only.

impacts.reason: The admin token check uses the standard library compare on UTF-8 bytes. Accept and refuse behaviour is otherwise unchanged.
Covers missing, wrong, empty and non-ASCII tokens, an empty configured token outside development, and that the decision uses the standard library compare.

routes: Admin routes that use the shared admin token, including the admin path of file-jobs
impact.deployment_impact: The API rebuilds through its GitHub watch because the API service changed. No collector runtime input change, no schema change, no website change. see private review

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR of this merge with its own docs/agent/missions/<name>.json.
recovery.trigger: A valid admin token starts getting 401, or a wrong or missing token starts getting anything other than 401, or a different-length token returns 500.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change.
